# Data Dawgs

> Forecasting, fantasy football, betting markets and EPA with receipts.
> All paths below are relative to https://datadawgs216.com/

Start with [`/data/index.json`](/data/index.json): dates, sizes and SHA-256 for every
machine file. Cite each payload's `as_of` with every number.

[`/data/surfaces.json`](/data/surfaces.json) maps pages to machine surfaces and all 42
live read-only MCP tools. `planned` is not callable. Two catalogs: `/mcp/core/<credential>`
serves 16 everyday tools; `/mcp/full/<credential>` and the bare `/mcp/<credential>` serve
all 42. Prefer core — 42 schemas cost real context. Every tool carries a title; none writes.
Identity and MCP credentials live on [`/signon.html`](/signon.html); `/connect.html` redirects
there. Signup is not a league seat; email confirmation gates credential minting only.
[Project instructions](/data/dawg-project-instructions.md) · [site guide](/data/site-guide.md).

Tiers: `labs`=Pup, unvalidated; `dawg`=Working Dawg, validated; `pound`=DawgHouse, stopped.

## The DawgHouse

- [The shelf](/dawghouse.html) + [inventory](/data/pound-tools.json): blocked NFL work with exact blockers + 44 CFB ideas. Fourteen production CFB tools ARE callable over MCP; roadmap ideas are not.
- [Contracts](/data/model-contracts.json): forecast fields, receipt rules and calculator I/O.
- [Provenance](/data/upstream-models.json): repos, commits, dates, licenses, integration mode.
- [NFL schedule](/data/nfl-schedule.json): 272 validated 2026 games, locked snapshot.
- [538 Classic Elo](/data/538-classic.json) ([method](/data/538-classic-methodology.md)): 32 ratings, 272 ungraded forecasts.
- [Normalized model receipts](/data/model-receipts.json): 1,088 append-only prospective forecasts, 4 model lines, 2 independent.

- [Calculators](/calculators.html): 10 deterministic calculators — odds, vig, EV, hedging,
passer rating, Elo, margin translation, forecast scoring, belief summary. Inputs are not stored.

## Hubs

- [Arena](/arena.html): games played against other people — Bozo, Guillotine, Survivor, DFS,
the live draft rig, a [32-team wins pool](/teamdraft.html).
Rendered from the `domain: "arena"` rows of surfaces.json; owns no data file.
- [Library](/data.html): every file in index.json, shelved by the surface that owns it, plus
the sources we read and do not republish. Owns no data file either.
- [NFL](/nfl.html): EPA, nfelo, calculators, and the blocked NFL work with its exact blockers.

## College football

- [CFB Lab](/cfb.html): explorer, matchup calculator, Elo backtest, divergence, and the 44-idea build roadmap (moved from the workbench 2026-08-09).
- [2025 results](/data/cfb-schedule.json), [latest games](/data/cfb-games-latest.json), [latest periods](/data/cfb-team-week-latest.json), and [ratings](/data/cfb-teams.json).
- [Book market](/data/cfb-market.json): timestamp unknown; not closing lines, so no CLV.
- [CFB Elo](/data/cfb-elo.json), [registry](/data/cfb-ratings.json) and [card](/data/cfb-model-cards.json): end-2025; retrodictive, modelled, ungraded, not consensus or forecast.
- [Fraud test](/data/cfb-record-divergence-validation.json): held-out aggregate only. [Disagreement](/data/cfb-disagreement.json): blocked on timestamped prices.
- [Prospective receipts](/data/cfb-model-receipts.json): append-only contract, zero rows; no CFB forecast has been frozen before kickoff.
- The 24-to-25-hour CFB market collector is staged; its endpoint is not live yet.

## Draft

- [Player pool + Market Value](/data/pool.json): 459 players; three auction formats; `as_of 2026-07-29`. MV is not projected points.
- [League](/data/league.json): 14 teams, $200, 15 spots, half PPR, no kicker.
- [2026 strategy](/data/strategy.md): positional curves and format playbooks; testable structure kept apart from analyst priors.

## Models and data

- [Team + QB EPA](/data/epa-teams.json): 2023-2025 nflverse play-by-play; descriptive, not predictive.
- [nfelo](/data/nfelo.json): ratings and backtest with the in-sample caveat.
- [Schedule + win probabilities](/data/survivor.json): 272 games; market-derived where available, model-derived otherwise.
- [Parameters](/data/models.json): margin, Bozo and survivor assumptions and limitations.

## Receipts and method

- [Pre-registered forecasts](/data/receipts.json): 272 calls locked 2026-08-06; the hash is in index.json.
- [Receipt method](/data/receipts-method.md): hypotheses, grading, hash reproduction, and what the tier collar means.
- [Bozo rules](/data/bozo-rules.json) ([prose](/data/bozo-rules.md)): open weekly one-leg parlay game.
- [House reasoning rules](/data/method.md): base rates, ranges, falsifiers and selection-bias checks.
- [Toto philosophy](/data/toto-philosophy.md): reasoning conventions for the site AI.

## Agent notes

- If a dated number is stale enough to affect the answer, say so.
- `def_epa_play` is EPA allowed: lower is better.
- Simulation and modelled output are labelled; do not present either as observation.
- Nothing here is betting advice.
- `/data/` is public, static, CORS-open and cheaper than the self-contained HTML pages.
